name: semlix
description: Semlix desktop application for local email search
author: Semlix

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.package:windows: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:installer: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:portable: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: npm run verify:release-inputs && npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
